subject: Reschedule: Peregrine Health demo — field tour + vacation overlap
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Peregrine demo (Apr 28) — itinerary clash

Hi Marissa —

Quick heads up: we originally penciled the Redwood demo for Thursday, Apr 28 at 10:00am EST. My team just added a short on-site field tour that morning (customer site visit to our Eastlake clinic) and I have family travel that afternoon—basically the day gets split into two tight windows.

I don't want to lose momentum on the pilot, but I also don't want to try to power through with poor connectivity. Two quick asks: can we either (A) move the live demo earlier/later that day, (B) do a short recorded walkthrough + 20-min live Q&A later, or (C) move to the following week? I'm flexible on formats.

Attaching our internal itinerary for Apr 27–29 so you can see the windows.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director, Digital Ops
Peregrine Health
Attachment: Peregrine_itinerary_0427.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine demo (Apr 28) — itinerary clash

Thanks for the context, Liam — appreciate the heads-up.

We can absolutely accommodate this. A few options that have worked well for similar on-the-road customers:

- Option 1 — Shift live demo by 90 mins the same day (we have an open slot at 11:30am EST or 2:00pm EST). Minimal prep, full run.
- Option 2 — Pre-record a 12–15 minute walkthrough of the core flows (we provide a clean narrative, you review), then run a 20–30 minute live Q&A at a time that suits you. We can host the recording on an expiring link.
- Option 3 — Move the whole session to the next week; we can hold the original slot for 48 hours while you confirm.

If you like option 2, Ben can take care of the recording and I can run the live Q&A. If you prefer shifting the live time, tell me which window on Apr 28 is best and I'll lock it.

Also cc'ing Ben to loop in logistics and the short agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Peregrine IT Ops <itops@peregrinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine demo (Apr 28) — itinerary clash

Marissa —

Thanks. Option 2 sounds safest given the field tour and then heading out on travel. A few notes:

- If you can record a 12–15 minute walkthrough that covers the ROI highlights (prefix caching, cost controls, routing policies) that would be ideal.
- We'd like the Q&A between 7:00pm–8:00pm EST on Apr 28 if Ben is available — that lands after my travel day and gives the crew time to digest.
- Please make the recording downloadable for internal review and also provide a short one-page agenda/slide we can forward to stakeholders.

I attached the itinerary so you can see exact times. Apologies for the late change — this was driven by an on-site opportunity.

Liam

Hi Liam —

Worked with our solutions team and we can deliver Option 2 easily. Plan I propose:

1) Recording: 12–15 min screen walkthrough focused on live routing, batching, and cost controls — sent to you by Apr 27 EOD for review.
2) Live Q&A: Apr 28 at 7:30pm EST (20–30 minutes). We'll have two engineers on the call to cover technical questions.
3) Deliverables: recording link (expiring 14 days), 1-page agenda and a short FAQ doc with common deployment patterns.

Attaching a draft agenda — if you want changes we can update before recording.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: demo-agenda-v1.pdf
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrinehealth.com>

Date: 2027-04-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine demo (Apr 28) — itinerary clash

Thanks both — that plan works for us.

Confirmed: recording to Marissa for review by Apr 27 EOD; live Q&A Apr 28 at 7:30pm EST. Please send a calendar invite and the recording link when available.

Two small asks for the live session: can you record the Q&A as well and drop a copy to our S3 bucket? We'll share upload creds with IT Ops (itops@peregrinehealth.com) via a separate secure channel.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to see the demo.

Liam
